text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for INC-4823 (api-hosted-high-latency). Trigger: hosted-api p95 latency > 1200ms across eu-west-1.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4823 created and routed to OnCall (alex). Escalation policy: oncall->secondary->manager.

alex: got the page, looking now. can someone drop any recent deploys?

maria: no deploys from infra in the last 30m. saw a gradual increase after 11:10 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: Page to alex timed out (no ack). Escalating to secondary (lee) per policy.

lee: sorry missed the first page, ack'ing now. what's the surface?

alex: acked 1923456798. seeing error spikes and long tail on requests to /v1/generate on hosted-prod. p95 ~1400ms. connection errors up 3x.

sam: adding traces — looks like a subset of requests hitting model-variant x-small-quant got OOMs and falling back to slower path. logs:
```
[11:12:03] model-runner: alloc failed on device 0: OOM
[11:12:03] runtime: falling back to cpu inference path
[11:12:04] proxy: request queued -> latency spike
```

katie: this matches the autoscaler activity — noticed a brief GPU flurry then nothing. maybe a scheduling problem on dedicated; checking cluster.

maria: customers A and C reported timeouts in the last 5m. severity: customer-facing, partial degradation.

ops-manager-bot: tagging severity P1. Notifying SRE rotation.

lee: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle heavy batch jobs to reduce load 2) pin requests to larger model-variant 3) temporarily disable x-small-quant rollout. who can kill the rollout?

alex: I can rollback the model rollout. deploying rollback now.

incident-bot: alex rolled back model rollout (rollout-id: rlt-77a).

sam: rolling back batch workers: `kubectl scale deployment batch-infer -n hosting --replicas=2` (was 8)

sam: scaled down batch workers and paused scheduled batch jobs.

katie: looking at cluster scheduler — a GPU pool node had a kernel panic and went into NotReady, pods stuck in Pending. kube rescheduled some but not enough capacity. opening a cloud support ticket for node replacement.

lee: can we route traffic to dedicated-dc-us-east temporarily? risk: cross-region latency but better than timeouts.

alex: enabling smart-routing fallback for eu-west -> us-east for model variants 2/3. enabling global fallback policy.

pagerduty-bot: Note: Escalation policy fired manager page to ops-manager (no ack yet).

ops-manager-bot: acked. I'm on it. coordinating with infra to spin up another GPU node.

maria: after rollback and scale-down, p95 dropped to ~600ms. errors reduced but still elevated (~1.2% errors).

sam: applied temporary cache-bypass fix for some malformed requests that were causing undue model work.

katie: cloud ticket updated: node replacement ETA ~12 minutes. provisioning a replacement node now (spot->on-demand fallback).

lee: good. next steps: keep rollback, maintain reduced batch workers, route ~20% traffic to us-east fallback, monitor for 15m. if stable, re-evaluate rollout strategy for x-small-quant.

alex: updating incident timeline and customer impact notes. customers affected: A (partial), C (timeouts), D (retry errors).

maria: preparing outbound status note: "We experienced elevated latencies and partial timeouts for some hosted API requests in eu-west-1 between 11:10–11:40 UTC. Root cause: GPU node outage causing model-variant fallback to CPU path and overload on remaining capacity." will ping support to notify impacted customers.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: On-call handoff scheduled in 45m. Reminder to capture post-incident follow-up.

lee: acked manager escalation at 1923456815. I'm staying on until stabilization. handoff planned to alex after 30m if metrics stay green.

alex: taking ownership of postmortem. will create runbook updates: - add health-check for model-variant OOMs - add faster autoscaler path to pre-warm replacement nodes - revise rollout canary to smaller % with explicit fallback gating.

sam: capturing commands used:
```
kubectl scale deployment batch-infer -n hosting --replicas=2
redwoodctl run rollback-rollout rlt-77a --env hosted-prod
redwoodctl routing enable global-fallback --from eu-west-1 --to us-east-1 --pct 20
```

maria: monitoring: p95 now stable ~480ms, errors ~0.3%. will keep the team posted.

ops-manager-bot: incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1923456822. continue watch for 60m.

lee: thanks everyone. quick wins logged. good coord. :thumbsup:

alex: final note: sales/CS notified. we'll have a postmortem doc and action items within 48h. closing thread when postmortem is published.
